title: Students cannot be compelled to recite Hindu prayers in government schools: Chhattisgarh High Court
description: The Chhattisgarh High Court on Thursday clarified that no child can be compelled to recite Hindu prayers in government schools [Abdul Salam Rizvi & Ors. v State of Chhattisgarh & Ors.].The Court was hearing a petition challenging a June 12 State government circular mandating Saraswati Vandana, Gayatri Mantra, Guru Mantra and other Hindu prayers in schools.Justice Amitendra Kishore Prasad recorded the State government's submission that although the circular has been implemented without an
